useCase: Sales intelligence portal embedding ThoughtSpot liveboards and Spotter AI into a Salesloft-branded experience. Demonstrates cadence analytics, rep performance, and AI-driven sales insights with a trial gating flow.
sampleQuestions: Which reps have the highest connect rates this quarter?
What cadences are driving the most meetings booked?
Show me pipeline coverage by stage.

useCase: Brand partner analytics portal giving restaurant and CPG brands row-level-secured visibility into their DoorDash sales performance, category trends, and AI-powered insights. Each brand sees only their own data, scoped by country via ThoughtSpot RLS formula variables.
sampleQuestions: What are my top-selling items this quarter?
How does my country performance compare month over month?
Which regions are showing the most growth?
rlsRules: dd_Country formula variable scopes data by country. Each user is assigned one or more country values; the liveboard and search queries filter to exactly those countries at query time.

useCase: Montana Department of Public Health & Human Services MIDIS Reconciliation Portal — disease surveillance data quality, case reconciliation, and Annual Case Review (ACR) reporting with county-level RLS and AI-powered data exploration.
sampleQuestions: What is the % completeness for DOB fields across all jurisdictions?
Show me case counts by jurisdiction for the current MMWR year.
Which counties are below the 95% completeness target?
rlsRules: JURISDICTION_NAME column filtered by ts_groups() — each user is in one county group, admins bypass RLS.
